Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE separate opaque restaurant office background layer for the approved Cogna business game, ART-28 DRE_ENVIRONMENT.
Input image 1 is the approved monthly DRE concept. Use ONLY the illustration at its upper right for the office architecture, perspective, palette and adult editorial cartoon rendering. Do not reproduce the complete UI.
Primary request: an empty small restaurant office seen from the front, warm ivory walls, a broad window on the LEFT with a glimpse of an exterior purple restaurant awning with absolutely no lettering, pale blue sky and green foliage; on the right, a modest rear bookcase with plain unlettered book spines and a leafy potted plant. Leave the middle and lower foreground open so separate seated character and desk layers can be added later. No front desk, no person, no chair, no foreground props. No framed poster.
Composition/framing: 4:3 landscape, desired 1024x768. Full bleed rectangular environment, no frame or rounded corners. Frontal eye-level camera, a slight view down toward the future desk; upright verticals. Window and awning read clearly behind the future seated woman.
Style: polished adult editorial cartoon matching the approved concept, clean dark-plum contours, broad restrained cel-shaded planes, subtle material texture. Warm soft daylight from upper left.
Palette: ivory #F5F0E8, plum #24113D, violet #6D28D9, lavender #B99AE8, warm wood and restrained green.
Backdrop: fully opaque, fill every pixel.
Text: none. No words, letters, numbers, labels, signs, slogans, logos, watermarks, paper, calculator, coffee cup, laptop, charts, axes, tables, data or UI. One background asset only.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: the attached restaurant office background. Make ONLY two corrections while preserving its 4:3 framing, architecture, awning, plants, bookcase, palette, contours and warm upper-left light.
1. Remove EVERY tiny human figure visible through the left window. Keep the outdoor restaurant terrace empty of people.
2. Remove the broad brown foreground tabletop/surface across the bottom approximately 17 percent of the image, including its horizontal back edge. Extend the SAME perspective wooden floor naturally all the way to the bottom edge instead. This is an empty OFFICE BACKGROUND layer; there must be NO foreground desk, table or counter at all.
Everything else remains unchanged. Desired 1024x768, full bleed fully opaque image. No person anywhere inside or outside, no chair, no front furniture, no text, letters, numbers, logos, paper, calculator, cup, UI, charts or data. ONE background layer only.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE separate transparent foreground desk sprite for Cogna monthly DRE ART-28 DRE_DESK.
Input image: approved monthly concept, ONLY the warm wooden desk in the upper-right illustration is a style/material reference.
Subject: one clean empty wooden analysis desk, viewed straight from the front with a modest view down onto its broad trapezoidal tabletop. Warm honey wood, dark-plum clean contours, restrained adult editorial cel shading, soft warm upper-left light. Two simple dark wooden legs and a plain front apron. Tabletop back edge is horizontal at about 20 percent of the image height, front edge at about 45 percent. Tabletop takes most of the width. Broad open empty tabletop for separate report, calculator and cup.
Composition: very wide 2:1 landscape, desired 1024x512. The entire desk including all four corners and leg ends must fit within the image, about 4 percent clear transparent margin at left/right and 8 percent at top/bottom. Symmetric frontal camera, little side rotation, same perspective/light as the concept. Tabletop plain wood only.
Background: TRUE RGBA transparency, alpha zero outside the desk and between its legs. No drop shadow, glow, floor, wall, scenery or checkerboard.
Absolutely no people, hands, chairs, paper, laptop, cup, calculator, plants, books, objects, labels, letters, numbers, symbols, charts, UI, logo or watermark. ONE desk only, a reusable independent scene layer, not a composite card.

Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: ONE independent transparent character sprite, CH01_DRE for Cogna monthly DRE ART-28.
Input image 1 is the CANONICAL IDENTITY MASTER of CH01. Preserve EXACTLY her facial structure, warm medium brown skin, dark brown eyes, short side-parted wavy dark brown bob ABOVE shoulders, gold hoop earrings, slim adult proportions, lilac button-up shirt with sleeves rolled to forearms, graphite trousers and black belt.
Input image 2 is the approved monthly DRE concept. Use only the upper-right illustration as the seated analytical pose / adult editorial style reference. Never reproduce its UI or text.
Primary request: CH01 seated, seen from the front in a subtle three-quarter turn, calmly analyzing a separate report that will be added later. Head gently inclined and eyes looking down toward image RIGHT. Her right elbow (image LEFT) is bent, with that hand resting lightly near her chin. Her other forearm (image RIGHT) extends gently forward at lower chest height; its hand has natural bent fingers and a visible thumb forming a loose pinch, as if gripping the RIGHT edge of an INVISIBLE upright report sheet. This grip hand is at about 74 percent image width, 60 percent image height, around waist height. There is EMPTY transparent space immediately to the LEFT of this grip hand for the later paper. Both hands complete, natural anatomy, five fingers per hand.
Framing: portrait 3:4, desired 768x1024. Seated upper-body figure from crown to upper thighs, not a standing pose. Show the torso, belt and the beginning of graphite thighs bending forward in a seated posture. Clean intentional lower cutoff at mid-thigh, later hidden behind a separate desk. Entire crown, hair, shoulders, elbows and hands inside the frame. About 10 percent transparent margin on all four sides.
Style: preserve the master clean dark-plum contours and broad restrained cel shading, polished adult editorial cartoon, warm upper-left daylight. Natural thoughtful small closed-mouth smile.
Background: TRUE RGBA TRANSPARENCY, alpha zero outside the person and in gaps. The reference master glow is NOT part of the person: do not reproduce any halo or glow.
No paper, clipboard, pen, laptop, props, desk, chair, furniture, floor, environment, shadow cloud, vignette, checkerboard, UI, text, numbers, charts, labels, logo or watermark. One exact CH01 only.
